testCase.name: [dev] S07 Search field × context: diagnosis matches in Hospital only, and only for Hospital records

descriptionHtml:
Bug B28 · P2 · known

Nursing Home cards show the diagnosis and Nursing Home search matches on diagnosis (the spec says neither)

Tickets: TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa; TFA-92579 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): AC 3 of TFA-92579 says the diagnosis shows on Hospital cards only, so TC-01/S02 and the Nursing Home diagnosis cells of TC-01/S03 and S26 fail on it too.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S02, TC-03/S09

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S07 Search field × context: diagnosis matches in Hospital only, and only for Hospital records

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U5 Nursing Home has no diagnosis: none on the Nursing Home card, and Nursing Home search does not match on diagnosis. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Standard fixture: {hospitalPatient} with diagnosis 'Community-acquired pneumonia'; {snfResident} on Today's Visits with diagnosis 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture'

When On the Hospital list search 'pneumonia', then 'hip fracture'. Switch to Nursing Home and search 'hip fracture' on Today's Visits, then on All Residents

Then Hospital × own diagnosis lists the patient. Hospital × the resident's diagnosis lists nobody (no cross-context match). Nursing Home × diagnosis lists nobody in either view and says no resident matches

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}; cp2 mustContain 'No patients match' and mustNotContain {snfResident}, {hospitalPatient}; cp3 and cp4 mustContain 'No residents match' (positive anchor that the query ran on the NH list) and mustNotContain {snfResident}, {hospitalPatient} and the word 'diagnosis'. …

Where it ran: dev unit U23; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

Searching the Nursing Home list for a diagnosis ('hip fracture') still finds the resident, and the search hint offers 'diagnosis', although Nursing Home search must not match diagnoses.

Evidence: dev U23 (ledger #23). Already in dev report §2 #4, cluster C1 (TFA-92581 AC 3). The Hospital diagnosis search is correct. S17 and S20 in the same unit pass.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S07

Search field × context: diagnosis matches in Hospital only, and only for Hospital records

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

Result: Fail from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U23.verdict.json), unit U23 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 88 turns, 263 s, $0.60.

Plan: unit U23 (#23, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Search box, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same search box, read-only typing (diagnosis words, names / MRN across contexts, fast re-type and whitespace). No part opens a chart or changes a row. Runs together with TC-03/S17, TC-03/S20.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #23, U23; checked: yes): Fail (S07 only, product — cluster C1) — S07: NH search for 'hip fracture' matches the resident by diagnosis (should say No residents match); search hint offers 'diagnosis'. S17 (search across mode switches), S20 (retype/clear/spaces) pass
